name: Tomoe Gozen
title: Warrior of Awazu
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: A renowned archer and swordswoman even among her fellow samurai, Tomoe Gozen was fiercely dedicated to her liege, commanding some of his most elite forces. As the world Shattered not long after his death, Gozen found herself adrift. She travels Izumo, battling its enemies and studying the competing daimyo to determine which—if any—is worthy of her service.
archetype_description: Increase all stats by 0.5% for each piece of chain armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Strong Hits against the same target increase the damage of this hero’s Ultimate Ability by 2% (stacking up to 15 times). Stacks reset when attacking a different target.

skills.name: Unrelenting Aim
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 10%HP+120%ATK with a 35% chance to inflict additional damage equal to 1% of the target’s MAX HP. If this attack is a Strong Hit, has a 40% chance to gain an Extra Turn.

skills.name: Yabusame Barrage
skills.description: Place [Sharpen I] on this hero for 2 turns then attack 1 enemy 5%HP+65%ATK 3 times. Each hit has a 35% chance to reduce the target’s ATK by 2% (stacking up to 10 times). If a hit is a Strong Hit, destroy the target’s MAX HP equal to 30% of the damage inflicted (cannot destroy more than 50% of the target’s MAX HP).

skills.name: Unyielding Onna-Musha
skills.description: Increase this hero’s CDMG% by 5% each time they attack the same target (stacking up to 6 times). Stacks reset when attacking a different target. At max stacks, increase the chance to Strong Hit by 10% and heal 5%MAXHP this hero when inflicting a Strong Hit.
